note: Nora means 'fearsome, awe-inspiring'; modern 'terrible' suggests 'very bad'.

kjv: seeing it (the angel's name) is secret
note: Peli (pil'i) is from pl' 'be wonderful, beyond comprehension', the same root as 'Wonderful' in Isa 9:6 and 'did wondrously' in v. 19; it denotes a name beyond human grasp rather than a hidden one.
Minchah here is the grain offering; 'meat' in 1611 meant food in general, not flesh.
Mahaneh-dan ('camp of Dan') is a place name (cf. Judg 18:12).
